title: Protocol and Vector
author: P. M. Underhill
blurb: Casper Kavanagh, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
